grounding.claim: UC6 Open the code behind a box: A reader picks the code link on a box. The file opens at that line, in their own editor or on the code host.
grounding.note: The trigger and the outcome no longer connect. Read viewer.js:14938-14945: the box-level open-source affordance (corner icon, cmd-click, double-click) is 'intentionally RETIRED' and `const srcNode = (_id) => null` disables all of them. Read openInCodeViewer at 14591-14605: on a served map a code link opens the file in the IN-APP code viewer, not an editor; only the code viewer header's arrow (13930) calls openSource (14914/14921), which builds the editor scheme URI or the GitHub blob URL. So a code link on a box does not open the editor or the code host — that needs a second click in the code viewer, and the direct box path is dead code. The map's anchor (13011) is renderElementDetails, a different behaviour again.
